candidates.title: Speculating Experts Accelerates Inference for Mixture-of-Experts
candidates.reason: Directly relevant MoE inference optimization: internal-representation-based future-expert prediction/prefetch overlaps CPU-GPU transfers with compute, includes speculative expert execution and fallback estimators, is integrated into an optimized engine, and reports TPOT improvement.

candidates.title: Pre-Attention Expert Prediction and Prefetching for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
candidates.reason: MoE expert-prefetch method using same-layer pre-attention activations and lightweight ranking-aware predictors, including first-layer prefetch and measured prediction accuracy across DeepSeek/Qwen/Phi MoE models. Relevant to expert prefetch/cache lineage.
